column1: Text
(Transcribed by UniScribe (https://www.uniscribe.co). Upgrade to remove this message.)
Nova, looks like you made it out alright.
But who's this chume? You two know each other? Nightmare Tacit Discord, the fucking name is that? Next time I see one, I'm blasting it.
Ugh, thanks for looking out for Lucy.

Name's Rebecca. Nice to meet you, chume. The f— Where'd you take us? The sum— what now? The Hyrule Star Torch? That's some kind of gang slang around here. Or no, wait, are they corp names? You know, like Arasaka? You ain't never heard of Arasaka? Ugh, this is bad.
Ugh, what the hell is going on? Nothing around here looks even halfway familiar. Am I stuck in some kind of bored brain dance? Ugh.

I want one! How many Eddies for the talking plushie? I'll buy one right this second. Huh? Who you calling a plushie? I'm an Echo. Rover and I go way back. Your partner? This little puffball? Tell me what you mean by Echo. That makes you sound like kind of a big deal, huh? Not that, you little turd. You're growling on me. Rebecca, this might take a minute. Ugh, whatever. This crap's way over my head anyway. Thanks.

Looking at me like I'm a ghost, geez. There's something on my face? Look out! Becca, you following most of this? Better off asking how much I didn't understand. Ew, why do they look like friggin' corpos? Seriously? Expect me to give you a lesson in lingo right now?

Whew, glad I made it. How'd you make that graffiti explode? So fucking nova. That spray can's some kind of weapon? That's... it's kind of hard to explain. Oh, actually, I was gonna ask. During the fight, I noticed... the clothes job on your gun. Is that, like, inspired by graffiti? Heh, spotted that, did ya? Picked the color scheme myself. Cream, right? Totally screams my style. Heh, keep the compliments rolling. Speaking of, your piece is killer too. Let me see.

Whoa, sick. Adorable and tuned to perfection? Plus that muscle model's legit, you know your iron. Name's Rebecca. Or Becca. Or Bex. Whatevs. Nice to meet you, Rebecca. Yeah, don't sweat it. Good chumes are good chumes. No matter where or when you find them, right? Then I'll come with. Ugh. Rebecca? Just remembered something I gotta hash out with Rover. You go ahead.

Damn it! We're still getting hacked even out of that hellscape? You alright? We know who's behind this. Wouldn't it be quicker if we just boom, blast that scop sucker to bits? Me? Nah, I'm good. Look, bouncing off the walls like usual, ain't I? Can't tell them apart. Hmm. What if you tried imagining them as stars? Pass. Don't wanna fry my circus with that stuff. Merk work suits me better than class work. Heh. That's a special-looking gun. Is it yours? Yep, custom job. Don't feel right walking around without iron in my pocket.
Is where you live really that dangerous?
Yeah, we've been vibing. I was just killing time. Didn't expect to get hooked.
Ended up carrying her through a few levels. Next thing you know, we're chumes. Gotta say, prefer co-op to the solo grind.

How's this thing work? Just lie back in the seat? Here, I'll help you set it up. What'd you want the difficulty to be? Maxed out, duh. Watch me clear it in one life. Finally a chance to show off my moves. Heh. Watch me roll credits before you can blink.
That's it? Barely even a warm-up.
Here. This is the prize you just won. What's this supposed to be, a puffer fish? Huh, not bad. Weirdly cute.

Here, you keep it. Huh? Are you sure? Thank you, coach. Coach? You talking to me? Yes, Coach Rebecca. I wanna learn from you. Maybe one day I can be just like you. Your shooting was incredible. Are you in a club? Where did you train? Uh, the Night City Club of Hyrule. So, tracked me down. What for? Let me be clear. If you're here to drag me back for an exam, I'll build this so fast you'll get whiplash.

What's this weird doodad? Dr. Hurson helped you apply for a terminal. Now I can ping your location and contact you whenever. Oh, nice. Thanks, chume. You free? If she's busy, gonna poke around the academy. Got a few things I wanna scope out. Plus gotta field test this bad boy. Hmm.
And done. Cream, right? Hell yeah. You got good taste.
Whoa, a kitty! Nice to meet you, kitty cat. Ugh, I'm not a cat. I'm the Ivory Gatekeeper.

Ugh. Listen, whiskers. No offense, but can you cut the meow act for a sec? And maybe use words I can understand. Meow. To put it in a way you can understand? If you collect all the shards, you can see David again. Lucy, you hear that? This is great news!
You ain't even the least bit happy? Hey, Lucy! For f— sake, better spell what's going on! Ugh, I get it. Lucy. Some things... if you don't say them now, might not get another chance.

Catch your breath. I'll handle the others. You can owe me one. Of all the faces to wear, had to be Adam Smashers. That Nightmare TD chose a grade 8 piece of sh— Night City's boogeyman of legend, and Arasaka's top hitman. Bastard's chrome to the gills, nothing gannick left in him. More killing machine than man. And he'll zero anyone Sokka tells him to. Anyway, just know that jerk wad's not someone you wanna mess with. Hi, coach. Chume, come on. Rather you used my name. Copy that, Coach Rebecca.

Whatever. Where are you headed anyway? I was just on my way to check on Verma and Fanella. Oh, here. Try this can, Coach Rebecca. It's a newest flavor. Maybe you'll like it. You guys live off cans too? Whew, sure, why not. Yo, what's up? Why so serious? Ran into a snag. We're trying to track down whoever did this. You mean this graffiti on the wall here? You're looking right at her. Cream, right? Heh. Huh?
Look, you can tell I'm not like you guys. It's pretty obvious I'm not from your world, ain't it?
Geez, kids here are sharp. Anyway, good. Makes laying out the facts easier. We're edge runners. Merks, essentially. Like a fine line between getting paid big and getting flatlined.
This too much of a downer for you or what? Absolutely not. I actually want to know more about Night City.
Hey, no way you're passing through without signing the guestbook first. Hell yeah. I like how you think, chume.
Sorry, dragged you two into this mess. Whoa, whoa. Don't gotta be like that with us. I think this is more of a celebration moment than a sorry one.
So, any idea what this shard's doing here? Maybe... David felt that someone was missing him, and it just... appeared?
Ooh, that's the version I'm choosing to believe. Felt someone missing him? Heh, sure. I'll buy that.
Right, now that that's wrapped up, gotta go grab my iron from Mornye and meet up with Luce. You chumes keep my masterpiece safe while I'm out and about, 'kay?
But they left a while ago. Do you know how you're gonna catch up? Come on. I'm sure Rebecca's already got a plan, right?
Falco! Where the hell's your jank-ass ride when I need it? Uh, not sure who this Falco is, but I've got an idea if you need to chase him down.
You're gonna party down by me?
Hey, I see the door.

Can thank our kitty cat friend for that. Thought I was a flatline for sure when I fell into cyberspace. Then bam, whiskers and the train swooped in to save our asses. Yeah, why a boring old train? The way you hyped it up, I expected a warp gate or something. Good kitty. Come here, let me pet you.

Why yapping like that? Listen, that's the Nightmare frequency's talking, not you. Piece together the dream van, get David back, and blow that chrome dome to f—ing smithereens. You both died that night. Adam Smasher killed you.

You're such a weirdo. Knew I was dead from the jump. We all die, Luce. As I see it, the timing don't matter so long as it means something. Knew what I signed up for when I told David I'd get him to the top of Arasaka Tower. Sucks, yeah. But if I'm already a flatline, I sweat it.
Listen, Lucy. David and I are gone. Nothing's changing that. We're only here now 'cause you remember us. 'Cause he still got something to say. And 'cause you're still breathing.
This is just a dream. No matter if reality's a f—ing meat grinder, you gotta wake up and face it. Even if you wake up and we ain't there.
Come on, you knockoff piece of sh— They pulled me out. Huh? So please enter me. I'll go to sleep anyway.
I couldn't wait for you to come out, little cobra.
Another evening in the snow with the rainbow. Turn away, I know the way to be where you feel like yourself. Dreamland's ready. One of the first messive years we've had at Kalina. Damn spiking words.
Alright, alright. Enough reminiscing. Got bigger biz right now, don't you? Becca, I— 'Cause you did everything to be there by yourself. Go on. Clock's ticking. So when you tell me all the reasons.

Ugh, don't know. Play tourist somewhere? Maybe find a cool echo as my new buddy? You know, honestly, kinda like it here at the academy. Could drag Sigirika and Lenae around to some classes, see what that's like. Gotta second crack at life. Gotta make it count. Find some fun and share it with the right chumes. What about you? Wanna be a cyberpunk? Seriously, Rover, I think you're built for it.
All said and done?
Don't give me that face. Can't handle all this mushy goodbye crap.
Later, Gunkbrain. Take good care of yourself, ya hear?
